subject: Tri-zone exec demo: finalizing overlap + DST edge-case handoff

Subject: Scheduling: Exec demo with Redwood Inference — timing constraints

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick response on the scope. We have three execs who need to attend: CTO (PDT), Head of Ops (CET), and APAC Head (SGT). Their windows are tiny and the APAC exec is only available before 10:30 SGT on weekdays. There’s also an internal note: our security/Vendor team fast-track review runs the week of Oct 30 — if the demo crosses the DST change for either region it complicates scheduling for them (they want any recordings timestamped before the change).

Can you propose 2-3 concrete slots next week that will work for all parties, bearing the DST cutover in mind? Ideally something short (30–45m) with time for a quick Q&A. If that’s impossible we may need a two-part approach.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
VP, Strategic Accounts
FinTek Solutions

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the constraints. Attached is a compact availability grid (exec-avail-grid.pdf) with candidate 30/45m windows converted across PDT/CET/SGT; I highlighted three that avoid the DST cutover ambiguity and one that sits on the cutoff (marked red). Quick notes:
- Best single-window candidate: Thu Oct 21 08:30 PDT / 17:30 CET / 00:30 SGT (Fri) — avoids the US/EU DST shift and keeps APAC early but may be slightly late for EU ops.
- Conservative two-part approach: 30m with US+EU execs during their overlap + 30m APAC-focused session next morning in SGT.
- We can also record the full run and provide a timestamped recording before Oct 30 if procurement requires it.

Would you prefer we propose the single overlap or the two-part canary? If single overlap, I’ll send a firm calendar invite and MAP (mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx) for signatures.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

+1 on the two-part canary in constrained scenarios. A few operational suggestions:
- Keep the first session focused on exec-level impact (SLA, uptime, cost delta) — 25m for slides + 10m for live Q&A.
- For APAC, trim the live Q&A to 10m and schedule an interactive follow-up deep-dive for product/infra folks next week.
- Offer to run the recorded portion through our observability console so their security folks can verify logs/timestamps before the Oct 30 window.

If Stephanie sends the invite, I’ll add a short Ops appendix and the runbook for fallback (region failover).

— Vivek
VP Product Ops
From: Tomiko Saito <tomiko@kensho.ai>

Hi all,

Thanks — from a procurement/security POV we prefer the two-part plan: it reduces the risk of a missed exec window and lets us get the security team their timestamped artifact before the cutover. Two small asks:
1) Can Redwood confirm the recording will be delivered as an MP4 with an embedded UTC timestamp and a separate SHA256 digest?
2) Please attach the NDA/DocuSign link when you send the MAP so legal can sign quickly.

If you can confirm those two items I’m happy to lock in Thu Oct 21 16:00–16:30 CET for the exec overlap and Fri Oct 22 08:30–09:00 SGT for the APAC follow-up.

Best,
Tomiko
Head of Vendor Risk — Kensho Financial (consulting for FinTek)
